correctness.rationale: For each nonempty truth-value fibre of a finite palette, the greatest positive accessibility grade (if any) attains the diamond maximum and the box minimum by monotonicity; a zero-only grade fibre contributes the neutral extreme. The finitely many attained extremes combine. A grade subset with no greatest element gives an unattained diamond using 1 on the subset and 0 elsewhere; complement the valuation for the box by B(x)=1−D(1−x). If the diamond supremum d is positive, the terms exceeding d/2 lie in its finite positive cut and their maximum equals d; if d=0, any world witnesses it, since W is nonempty. For necessity under upper accumulation choose a positive grade limit t from distinct worlds in an infinite cut. First choose positive deficits δ_j=1−s_j→0 in the palette, then distinct worlds with |r_v−t|<δ_j/2. Each selected contribution lies strictly below t and tends to t; all others contribute zero. This handles convergence from either side and repeated grades. The reflected argument is for palettes accumulating at 0 for the box. With FPC at every world the argument takes arbitrary truth vectors, so nested subformulas need no separate closure assumption. The truncation difference is bounded by the supremum of omitted grades (zero for no omissions); taking x=0 on F, x=1 off F attains it for the diamond, and the complemented vector does so for the box. The error is for genuine truncation, not a claim about the best arbitrary approximant on that coordinate set. An infinite cut prevents continuity at the zero/one vector respectively since a basic product neighborhood controls only finitely many coordinates. The grade-one examples reduce to suprema and infima of palette subsets, which verifies the two one-sided separations. /workspace/review_replay.py independently checks the finite arithmetic on 512 exact rational row/cut pairs; infinite claims use the proof, not finite prefixes.

evidence: For a fixed grade r, letting g_r(x)=min(r,x) and l_r(x)=max(0,r+x−1), we have l_r(x)=g_r(l_r(x)) and g_r(x)=l_r(1−r+g_r(x)). Both coordinatewise substitutions are continuous, preserve the coordinate term values, and work also in finite restrictions. They transfer the unrestricted attainment, product continuity and sharp truncation result from Gödel possibility, in both directions.

The substitutions generally change the truth palette in a grade-dependent way, so they do not transfer a fixed restricted-palette assertion. At grade one, the Łukasiewicz modalities reduce to sup and inf on that infinite set; opposite endpoint palettes then separate them.
Rowwise unrestricted attainment applies to any subformula evaluation vector, so arbitrary-depth witnessing under framewise FPC is a direct corollary, not independent novelty.

Those full-cube pieces are not an independent priority claim. The corresponding earlier fixed-palette Gödel claims have materially different box conditions. value.rationale: The discontinuous change in the class of witnessing frames as atomic palettes begin to accumulate at just one endpoint is a meaningful semantics boundary. A single grade-one row has all finite-palette witnesses but loses only one operator when the palette approaches the corresponding endpoint; this shows why the two thresholds are not interchangeable without reflecting the palette. The rowwise criterion explains how infinitely many nonzero successors can still suffice at arbitrary formula depth. The value is in the exact assumptions and separating examples, not in claiming a new general topology theorem or a full classification of infinite palettes.
